query:
INSERT INTO read_states (user_id, article_id, is_read, read_at, created_at, updated_at)
            VALUES (?, ?, 1, ?, ?, ?)
            ON CONFLICT(user_id, article_id) DO UPDATE SET
                is_read = 1,
                read_at = excluded.read_at,
                updated_at = excluded.updated_at
